description.en-us: The Panda Treat is a rapid-install edible ink adapter for compatible 3D printers. It transforms a standard 3D printer into an edible ink printer for printing food-safe ink onto prepared food and drink surfaces.
description.zh-cn: Panda Treat 是一款适用于兼容 3D 打印机的快速安装食用墨水适配器，可将标准 3D 打印机转换为食用墨水打印机，用于在已准备好的食品和饮品表面打印食品级墨水。
